responsibility: Provides the non-generated support code and exported entry points used by GCC’s autogenerated GIMPLE pattern matcher. It defines gimple_match_op resimplification for one- through seven-operand operations, canonicalization and constant-fold dispatch, conditional-operation rewriting to IFN_COND_* forms, and public helper queries such as canonicalize_code, commutativity/associativity tests, target direct-support checks, and conditional-internal-function lookup, serving as the reusable bridge between gimple-match.cc, gimple-fold, and other middle-end clients.
